blocks.text: For a January 15 departure from SFO to Bangkok, the clearest choice is between getting to Bangkok earlier on January 16 and leaving later on January 15 for a slightly shorter overall trip. Both direct award options below connect once in Hong Kong and show the same 65,000-point Aeroplan quote and CAD 107.40 in taxes and fees.
Choose this schedule if arriving the evening before matters: it reaches Bangkok on January 16, but departs SFO 11 hours 30 minutes earlier than the later-departing alternative.
blocks.label: Earlier Bangkok arrival

blocks.text: If you would rather keep more of January 15 at home, the next option leaves SFO at 11:15 p.m. and arrives at 9:50 a.m. on January 17. Its elapsed time is five minutes shorter, but it gets you in a day later by the calendar than the earlier-arrival choice.
This is the shortest elapsed-time journey in the eligible pool.
blocks.label: Later departure, shorter trip

claims.proposition: Journey equals Ranking's complete-pool elapsed-time reference
claims.text: This is the shortest elapsed-time journey in the eligible pool.

blocks.text: For a cash comparison, the endpoint-pair search returned a $440 SFO–Bangkok itinerary arriving the morning of January 17. A $525 quote in the same search arrives at 11:40 p.m. on January 16, so it offers an earlier local arrival at a higher quoted fare. These are cash-search results, not award recommendations; the search does not establish whether either amount is per traveler or a party total.
A returned cash quote for the requested airport pair; its price scope is not established.

blocks.text: This higher quote arrives on the earlier local date.

blocks.text: There is also a distinct business-class possibility, but it means positioning from SFO to LAX on a separate cash ticket, then taking the award onward via Istanbul. The award journey is listed as business class. It departs SFO at 6:18 a.m. and reaches Bangkok at 8:50 a.m. on January 17; that is a 35-hour-32-minute trip, so the cabin comes with a much earlier start and a longer journey than the direct award choices.
The award itinerary is identified as business class.
blocks.label: Business via LAX

blocks.text: The business award is quoted at 275,000 Turkish miles, while the direct choices are quoted in Aeroplan points; those programs’ totals are not directly comparable. The LAX positioning quote is $86, but its price scope is unknown, and the award taxes are not reported—so these figures do not establish an all-in price. The direct award evidence supports the requested one traveler, but the separate-ticket business itinerary does not confirm traveler or seat availability. Its SFO–LAX flight and LAX–Bangkok award are separate bookings: baggage handling, check-in and terminal arrangements, transit requirements, and missed-connection protection are unverified. All source observations are dated October 9, 2026, not live availability.
